key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:0818
name: find_value_in_string_array
description: Walks a null-terminated array of string pointers, calling a comparison routine on each entry, and returns the text after the equals sign in the matching entry. Returns zero when no entry matches.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:0836
name: scan_string_table_for_value
description: Iterates over a null-terminated table of string pointers and compares each entry, returning the text that follows the equals sign for the first match. Returns zero when the table ends without a match.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:0856
name: find_value_in_pointer_list
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of pointers, testing each entry through a comparison routine, and returns the text after the equals sign of the first entry that matches. Returns zero if the list is exhausted.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:0864
name: find_bar_segment_matching_target
description: Splits a string on vertical bars and checks each segment: its length must equal a supplied value and its text must compare equal to the target. Returns one when a segment matches and zero when the string ends.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:087E
name: scan_bar_segments_for_target
description: Steps through a vertical-bar separated string segment by segment, comparing each segment's length and text with a target. Returns one on the first full match and zero when no segment matches.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:0896
name: walk_bar_segments_for_target
description: Walks the segments of a vertical-bar separated string, stopping at the end of the string, and reports one when a segment has the expected length and matches the target text. Otherwise it reports zero.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:08BE
name: test_bar_segment_length_match
description: Advances through bar-separated segments and checks whether a segment's length equals the expected value and its text compares equal. Returns one on success and zero when the string runs out.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:08C8
name: search_bar_segments_by_length
description: Iterates over vertical-bar separated segments from the start of the string, testing each segment's length and text against the expected values. Returns one on a match and zero if the string ends first.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:08D6
name: parse_copy_count_string
description: Clears a status byte in the output record, then compares the input text with the reference phrases for a copy label. When a decimal number follows the prefix, it is parsed and used to build the label; otherwise the plain copy text is stored.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:0926
name: parse_copy_number_suffix
description: Locates the reference text at a fixed position after the input pointer, then reads decimal digits and checks a closing phrase. Both the success and failure paths make the same two library calls, and nothing is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:0948
name: parse_decimal_count_suffix
description: Reads a run of decimal digits from the text, then checks that the following text matches the reference phrase. Both outcomes end with the same two library calls and nothing is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:094C
name: parse_decimal_count_field
description: Accumulates decimal digits from the text until a non-digit is reached, then compares the remaining text with the reference phrases. Both outcomes make the same two library calls and nothing is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:09BE
name: convert_digit_char_to_value
description: Returns the numeric value of a character when it is a decimal digit from zero to nine, and minus one for any other character.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:3:09D6
name: stub_return_minus_one
description: A stub that does nothing except return the constant minus one. It is a stub that always reports failure to its callers.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:9:0000
name: forward_call_through_library_base
description: Loads a library base pointer from a global variable and calls a routine at a fixed negative offset from that base, discarding any result. It is a plain forwarding stub for a library call.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:8:0030
name: invoke_library_routine_stub
description: Calls a library routine through a library base pointer held in a global variable and returns nothing. It is a minimal forwarding stub around one library call.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:1:0000
name: chain_two_step_library_call
description: Calls a routine with the last two arguments and, if it returns a non-zero handle, calls a second routine with the first two arguments and that handle. If that second call fails, it passes the handle to a third call and returns zero.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:1:004E
name: allocate_cleared_record_block
description: Requests a cleared memory block of 96 bytes through a library call. On success it stores the value ten into two fields of the block, passes the block to another routine, and returns whether allocation succeeded.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:1:008A
name: stub_return_zero
description: A stub that does nothing except return zero. It reports success or an empty result to its callers without doing any work.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:1:0092
name: verify_call_result_matches
description: Calls another routine with three of its arguments and compares the result with the fourth argument. It returns the fourth argument when they match and zero otherwise.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:1:00BC
name: verify_library_result_matches
description: Calls a library routine with three arguments and returns the fourth argument when the result equals it. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:1:00E2
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on its callers.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:6:0000
name: divide_32_bit_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns both the quotient and the remainder. Large divisors use a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop, while small divisors are divided directly in two 16-bit halves.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:6:0020
name: shift_subtract_division_loop
description: Runs a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract division, shifting dividend bits into a running remainder and subtracting the divisor whenever the remainder reaches it. Quotient bits build up in the low half of the working value and nothing is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:6:0040
name: multiply_two_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products, combining the two cross products with the low-by-low product. The result is returned as a 64-bit pair.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:6:00C8
name: call_exec_raw_format_routine
description: Calls the exec library formatted-output routine, passing its arguments through registers, by reading the function address from a library base stored in a global variable. Nothing is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:6:00EC
name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory location held in the address register. It performs a single one-byte store and returns nothing.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0000
name: measure_c_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string by decrementing a counter for each non-zero byte, then returns the complement of that counter, which is the string length.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0010
name: find_char_in_c_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for the given byte and returns a pointer to its first occurrence. It returns zero if the terminator is reached before a match.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0026
name: stub_return_zero_status
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. It is a stub that reports an empty or unsuccessful result to its callers.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:002C
name: copy_c_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into a destination buffer byte by byte, including the terminator. Nothing is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0038
name: append_c_string
description: Finds the terminating zero byte of the destination string and copies the source string, including its terminator, to follow it. Nothing is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0048
name: compare_c_strings_limited
description: Compares two byte strings for up to a given number of characters. It returns zero when the strings match through the limit or the terminator, and one as soon as a byte differs.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0064
name: stub_return_one
description: Returns one and does nothing else. It reports success to its callers without doing any work.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:006C
name: advance_string_within_limit
description: Steps through a string at most a given number of characters, stopping at its terminator. When the terminator is reached it makes one call to another routine with no arguments, and it returns nothing.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0080
name: forward_single_call_stub
description: Makes one call to another routine with no arguments and then returns. It only passes control on and does no work of its own.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:5:0092
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into a destination buffer of a given length, stopping at the terminator. It then fills the rest of the buffer with zero bytes up to that length.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:7:0000
name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Initialises a three-word list node in place. The first word is set to the node address plus four, the second word is cleared, and the third word stores the node address.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:0000
name: validate_record_and_dispatch
description: Returns one when given no record. Otherwise it runs a check call with a size of twenty and, if the check passes, makes two further calls, one of which receives the pointer stored in a fixed field of the record. It returns the result of that last call.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:007A
name: process_linked_record_list
description: Walks a chain of records through a next pointer stored at a fixed field. For each record it makes two calls, one with a size of sixteen and one using a pointer and a scaled byte value from the record, and it returns one when the chain ends or zero if a call fails.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:008C
name: walk_record_chain_checking_calls
description: Follows a chain of records through the next pointer at a fixed field, making two checking calls on each record. It returns one when the chain ends after every check passes, and zero when either check fails.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:00D4
name: stub_return_zero_value
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. It reports an empty result to its callers without doing any work.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:00DC
name: allocate_checked_record_block
description: Allocates a cleared twenty-byte block through a library call and runs two checking calls on it. A value from a further call is stored in a field of the block. It returns the block on success, zero when no request is made, and minus one when any step fails.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:01A4
name: stub_return_failure_code
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else, signalling failure to its callers.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:01AC
name: build_linked_record_chain
description: Allocates cleared sixteen-byte records through library calls and links each new record to the previous one. A size is computed from a byte field of the record times four, and each record is checked by two calls. It returns the first record, or minus one when an allocation or check fails.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:01C2
name: link_new_records_into_chain
description: Makes a sequence of calls that each produce a record, links each record to the previous one through a next pointer, and stores a further pointer in the record. It returns the first record of the chain, or minus one when any call fails.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:01EC
name: build_record_chain_until_end
description: Repeatedly creates records through library calls, storing each record in the pointer field of the previous one. When the chain ends it returns the first record, and it returns minus one when any call fails.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:libs/icon.library:2:0278
name: stub_return_error_code
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else, reporting an error result to its callers.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:Populous.II:0:0000
name: relocate_hunk_and_launch
description: Program entry code that copies a block of bytes backwards, then examines a hunk-format header for relocation records and adds a base value to each relocated word. It finishes by writing a short block of instructions and jumping to it.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:Populous.II:0:0066
name: accumulate_32bit_from_bytes
description: Reads four consecutive bytes from the address in the address register and joins them into one 32-bit value in the data register, with the first byte in the highest position. The value is returned.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:Populous.II:0:0072
name: decode_bits_and_copy_backwards
description: Reads a variable-length code from a bit stream, using a table in global data to decide how many bits to read, and then copies that many bytes backwards from one buffer position to another. It does nothing when its initial flag is clear.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:Populous.II:0:00BE
name: empty_routine
description: Performs no work and returns to its callers at once.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:Populous.II:0:00C8
name: call_table_indexed_routine_loop
description: Calls another routine once and uses the result as an index into a table in global data. When the table byte at that index is non-zero, it calls another routine repeatedly until the returned value is zero.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:Populous.II:0:00FC
name: decode_stream_until_zero
description: When a control value equals two it makes one call and then repeats another call until it returns zero. Otherwise it repeats a call until a flag ends the loop, then repeats a second call until it returns zero.

key: Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods.adf:Populous.II:0:017E
name: delay_countdown_loop
description: Spins by decrementing a counter until it reaches zero, then returns. It is a pure countdown loop with no other effect.
